title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-003
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA source files and correspondence regarding the investigation of the JAL 1628 UFO incident, confirming the presence of encounter reports.

encounters.summary: JAL Flight 1628 pilot Captain Kenju Terauchi reported observing unidentified lights and a giant walnut-shaped craft while flying over Alaska, which he claimed paced his aircraft.
encounters.entity_behavior: paced the aircraft, stopped in front of the cockpit, undulating lights
encounters.quote: two spaceships stopped in front of our face, shooting off lights
